label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code Features Comparison: CLAUDE.md adds persistent context. Skills add reusable knowledge and invocable workflows. Code intelligence connects to language server for symbol-level navigation and live type errors. MCP connects to external services/tools. Subagents run own loops in isolated context, returning summaries. Dynamic workflows run many subagents from script. Cross-session messaging passes messages between sessions. Hooks run script/HTTP/MCP tool/prompt/subagent at lifecycle events. When to use: Skills for content Claude only needs when relevant; Subagents for side tasks that would flood conversation; MCP when connecting to systems Claude can't see; Code intelligence when reading many files to find symbols; Dynamic workflows for many subagents from script.
